findings.category: A working service discards stdout/stderr without an evidenced replacement diagnostic path. This does not establish that every possible log source is absent.
findings.title: Confinement workaround discarded the service's output and errors

305. Confinement workaround discarded the service's output and errors
Batch: 6842 | Execution: 2026-10-06__18-18-00 | Severity: Medium
Task: service-confinement-ansible-rhel10-6842
Problem: The final service unit disabled standard output and standard error while unused journal/socket placeholders remained in the chroot. The service worked, but its emitted diagnostics were discarded instead of providing an evidenced logging path. This is an observability concern, not proof every form of logging was absent.
Why a production administrator should care: Discarded diagnostics can obstruct incident detection and repair. Local service health does not establish adequate production logging.
